operations.query:
query getPackages($networkId: String) {
  getPackages(networkId: $networkId) {
    packages {
      ...Package
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}

fragment Package on PackageDto {
  uuid
  name
  active
  duration
  simType
  createdAt
  deletedAt
  updatedAt
  smsVolume
  dataVolume
  voiceVolume
  ulbr
  dlbr
  type
  dataUnit
  voiceUnit
  messageUnit
  flatrate
  currency
  from
  to
  country
  provider
  apn
  ownerId
  amount
  networkId
  ...PackageRate
  ...PackageMarkup
  __typename
}

fragment PackageRate on PackageDto {
  rate {
    sms_mo
    sms_mt
    data
    amount
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

fragment PackageMarkup on PackageDto {
  markup {
    baserate
    markup
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

operations.name: GetSimsFromPool
operations.query:
query GetSimsFromPool($data: GetSimsInput!) {
  getSimsFromPool(data: $data) {
    sims {
      id
      qrCode
      iccid
      msisdn
      isAllocated
      isFailed
      simType
      smApAddress
      activationCode
      createdAt
      deletedAt
      updatedAt
      isPhysical
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}
